Actual delayed API loads showed 6 desktop/2 phone shimmers, 20-to-40 loaded items, bounded virtualized mounts and successful failure/retry recovery. Reduced motion computed animation none and overlay opacity 0. No overflow at exercised 360/375/390/560/1280 surfaces; narrowest two-column badge gap 45px; level contrasts 12.94/8.51/8.42. Hallmark rendered five isolated consent captures with 0 failures/0 Reflex/4 reviewed warnings; independent fresh-context source and completed-thumbnail mobile/desktop review returned ship. Warnings concern a hidden new-tab suffix, consent/removal labels proven to fit at 320px, and intentional active-navigation versus primary-action treatments. Consented functional captures are separate from automated consent-only renders.
